a changed unit price, total, session window, availability, cancellation rule, capacity, form deployment or project mode invalidates the stored plan with FAILED/PRECONDITIONS_CHANGED_PREPARE_AGAIN and never dispatches at the new values
the project directory mode is checked before any mode-specific page request; a declared mismatch or an unregistered mode is refused with INVALID_ARGUMENTS

refund acceptance (REQUESTED/REFUNDING/PENDING/MANUAL), platform settlement (REFUNDED) and arrived-money verification are separate; refund_arrived_verified is always false
cancel plans bind the own record, scene, sites, time span, reservation/approval/payment/refund states, extended status, amounts and cancelBeforeStart; a changed rule or state invalidates the plan

a normally effective order (RESV_EFFECT + approval pass) can prepare a cancel plan; it hands off OFFICIAL_CANCEL_CONTROL, paid orders also add CONFIRM_REFUND_CONSEQUENCES, and only ended/cancelled/expired/unmapped orders are refused

unrelated malformed order rows are ignored; a malformed row that looks like this plan keeps the result UNKNOWN, and a malformed gmtCreate never raises out of reconciliation

the side-effect ledger records official_request as NOT_SENT before dispatch and SENT at the moment the single-use gate accepts the request; a lost response or process death keeps SENT

out_of_scope_handoffs.reason: The transaction engine has no terminal NOT_CREATED state or controlled close/abandon entry; the adapter must not fabricate a remote record. 5.2 keeps UNKNOWN and never replays; 4.4 must provide the state.

The engine consumes the authorization at claim time. 5.2 converts pre-dispatch failures into definite not-sent, but not consuming the authorization on failure requires an actions.py change owned by 4.4.

Blocking service workers at browser-context creation (browser.py service_workers='block') would remove the condition entirely; library_wire.py has the same observation assumption. The 5.2 adapter-side mitigation already prevents the repeat-write path.

verified_cases: a free plan binds the precheck snapshot, dispatches once through the exact signed URL, records official_request as SENT and verifies the synthetic remote record on a lost response
a changed unit price, total, session availability, time or cancellation rule makes execute return FAILED/PRECONDITIONS_CHANGED_PREPARE_AGAIN with zero dispatches
the plan binding is stable across different checked_at values but changes when the price or cancel rule changes
a page row from another project is rejected with SPORTS_SCENE_MISMATCH by the read layer; an unregistered or mismatched mode is refused before any mode-specific page request
person mode always hands off ticket quantity and stays AWAITING_OFFICIAL without dispatch; the preview states one TICKET
official captcha verification keeps the plan AWAITING_OFFICIAL on repeated execute and result
an unknown total is never derived from the unit price; the plan hands off to the official settlement page and does not dispatch
expected_total_fen disagreeing with the source payableAmount is SPORTS_FEE_CHANGED
an unpaid order reports PENDING_PAYMENT with the platform deadline and declared deadline state; the same record with paid + approval pending reports PENDING_APPROVAL and payment_status PAID
repeated execute/result calls on one unresolved plan keep the synthetic dispatch count at one and verify SUCCEEDED only after the record appears
a successful cancel with refund REFUNDING reports refund_accepted=true, refund_settled_by_platform=false and refund_arrived_verified=false
a normally effective order (RESV_EFFECT + approval pass) prepares an official cancel plan; a paid one adds the refund confirmation and reads back SUCCEEDED with REFUNDING
an ended or already cancelled order is refused with SPORTS_CANCELLATION_NOT_AVAILABLE
a short own-order page, two similar records or a disagreeing detail keeps the result UNKNOWN; an unrelated malformed row does not block a valid match
a malformed candidate row or a malformed gmtCreate keeps the result unknown without raising
a delayed order created after plan expiry but within the 24-hour dispatch window is matched; an order created before dispatch is not attributed to the plan
a rate-limited readback keeps UNKNOWN with CHECK_RESULT_ONLY_DO_NOT_RESEND and never dispatches again
a definite not-sent dispatch ends FAILED/REQUEST_NOT_SENT with official_request NOT_SENT and no retry
an unobserved fetch after the page returned becomes UNKNOWN with official_request UNKNOWN and no replay
an observed abort or a NO_PENDING script is definitely not sent
pre-dispatch re-read and signed-URL preparation failures are definitely not sent
expired or cancelled payment makes the plan FAILED
a numeric payType is recorded (source_pay_type/matches_plan/verified=false) without blocking the record match
with THU_SPORTS_WRITE=0, order reads, describe and reconciliation keep working while prepare is refused with SPORTS_WRITES_DISABLED; with THU_SPORTS_READ=0 pending reconciliation is suspended
official URLs lose signing query values; foreign hosts and URL credentials fall back to the personal reservation page
the capability table exposes exactly the two legacy sports operations, one session/ticket per mode, the precheck/payment notes and no new tool names; its return is isolated from MODE_CONTRACT
cancel preview amounts stay exact integer fen (12345 -> 123.45), record the payment state, do not publish site_ids and stay bound to the site list through the fingerprint
cancel preparation requires a complete own-record search; a missing record stays non-success
every SPORTS_* literal used by the adapter is registered in the error classification
limits: Offline synthetic verification only: no real campus login, availability read, reservation creation, cancellation, payment or refund was performed.

The sports-action-v1 input schema is frozen in actions.py (4.4): there is no quantity parameter. SPORT_GROUP is one session and SPORT_PERSON one self ticket; multi-ticket, multi-person ticket and reschedule flows must use the official page.

The plan business schema is string-only; quantity/unit/total are separated in the preview text and the source fen values are bound in the fingerprint. Structured amounts are exposed in the result platform.amounts.
payType request/response enum domains have no real sample; the adapter records and soft-matches the value instead of blocking. Real creation needs a local verification.
resvExtendStatus bit 256 is a defensive official-control handoff with no source sample; it never triggers direct dispatch.
Delayed-order reconciliation is bounded to 24 hours after dispatch and requires gmtCreate. A record without gmtCreate or created before dispatch is not attributed to the plan.
There is no terminal not-created state after the window: the plan stays UNKNOWN and is never replayed until 4.4 adds NOT_CREATED or a controlled close entry.
Cancel readback confirms the own record by id, scene and exact time; the site list is bound in the plan fingerprint at prepare time and is not compared again after the cancellation.
refund_arrived_verified is always false; refund_settled_by_platform only mirrors the platform refund enum and does not prove the money reached the payer.
A persistently short, repeated or over-50-page order list still blocks a new prepare; one transient short page is retried once.

sports.py, queries.py, actions.py, action_store.py, browser.py and mcp_stdio.py were not modified; order reads, precheck, the four status axes and cross-project rejection remain 4.3/3.2/4.4 contracts.

rollback: Set THU_SPORTS_WRITE=0 to stop new plans and execution while keeping order reads, describe and unresolved reconciliation; THU_SPORTS_READ=0 also suspends reconciliation. For a code rollback restore sports_actions.py and sports_transport.py to 37b1605, delete tests/test_sports_actions.py and revert the nine error-code registrations and the source-registry line sync. Do not undo any real reservation or cancellation, do not trigger refunds and do not delete unresolved plans or official references. Added evidence fields are optional and old clients ignore them.
